sources.location: Independent conceptual camera framing and lens diagrams authored for this gallery
sources.method: Scope and distinctions were recorded from the 33-item camera mapping contract; no source media was copied.
Live Chromium browser observation at 1440x1000 with filter, search, theme, Canvas and card-state checks.

evidence.finding: The public package contains 33 unique itemId/previewId pairs, all in the framing namespace, each with motion:false and explicit explanation, limitation and QA fields.

evidence.locator: live page: header, filter group, cards and Canvas labels
evidence.finding: The gallery renders 33 cards, reports 24 framing and 9 optics/environment items, and exposes named controls and Canvas previews.
The wide layout uses a two-column card grid, search/filter controls and a 12792px scrollable collection before filtering.
The warm neutral/dark green palette, Canvas diagram grammar and explanatory card hierarchy are authored for this standalone gallery, not extracted from a third-party product.

prototype.reason: The gallery needs inspectable, dependency-free previews and deterministic draw calls for 33 diagrams; a framework or backend would add no value to this reference package.

new_screen.reason: The standalone atlas screen is the new screen and was observed rendering all 33 cards with Canvas previews.

visual.reason: Live Chromium observation confirmed the card grid, Canvas previews, typography hierarchy, warm/dark surfaces and card detail density.

states.reason: Search for 망원, optics/environment filter, dark mode, redraw buttons, source links and empty-result-capable filtering were exercised.

responsive.reason: CSS breakpoint rules were checked statically and the wide live viewport was rendered without horizontal overflow; physical mobile devices were not tested.

accessibility.reason: Live accessibility observation confirmed named search, filter/theme controls, aria-pressed state, Canvas labels, source links and visible focus behavior. This is not a complete WCAG audit.

publication.notes: Authored Canvas diagrams and text only. No source video, GIF, private media, account data, logos or redistributed third-party assets are included. Public target is the personal ui-references GitHub Pages gallery.
